'''Outer Curved Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="CL 2016" />

==History==
[[File:Labor_droids.png|thumb|left|250px|Another view of the street.]]
[[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled down this road en route to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. A [[GR-45 medium transport]] was illegally parked in the street at this [[time]].<ref name="CL 2016" />
